facts.fact: Senegal's regulator ARTP and the Gambia's PURA signed an MoU to implement the ECOWAS Community Roaming Regulation (capped charges, free incoming calls up to 30 days, direct routing, joint fraud monitoring); signing date not given, the page's published date of 2025-12-15 is used.
